input.summary: Kessling County RFP 2026-041 janitorial: 22 in-scope sites registered (Table 3-1 Sites 1-17 as printed, 480,090 SF; Parks Sites 18-21 from Section 3.4; Site 22 and the Site 4 revision to 46,210 SF from Addendum No. 1, giving the revised 18-building total of 489,830 SF). Contractor cleaning areas recorded for Sites 6 (69,150), 8 (5,850) and 10 (4,350). Six out-of-scope buildings (Section 3.5 and the Lakeview concession stand) and two information-only grounds areas registered with status. Incumbent Northern Shores Building Services, Inc., KC-23-0412, $1,094,880/yr.
unresolved: Excluded rooms inside in-scope buildings have no stated area (Site 1 Historical Society archive room, Site 2 server room, Site 4 lab and pharmacy, Site 7 evidence room, Site 11 commercial kitchen, Site 12 kennels/holding/surgery); gross areas used as printed.

Sites 17 and 21 are on-call (per event / per rental); service days set from Attachment B estimated quantities (31 events, 58 rentals), not guaranteed. Site 13 also has on-call EOC activation cleaning (~2/yr, hourly).
Kessling County Airport terminal (Section 3.5 f) is excluded and no area is printed.
Grounds maintenance is not part of this RFP; Courthouse square (2.3 ac) and Lakeview mowed turf (14 ac) registered as excluded, information only.
